decisions.title: Authorize pushing build/roadmap-p3-completion to origin, superseding DEC-0001's KEEP_LOCAL_ONLY for this branch
decisions.decision: ONE push of ONE branch: 'git push origin build/roadmap-p3-completion', non-force, to the ALREADY-CONFIGURED remote origin (github.com/SHAHID8142/Shahid-Master-Skill.git). No other branch, no tag, no force-push, no remote-URL change, no remote deletion, no fetch/pull/deploy/publish beyond what this push requires. DEC-0001's KEEP_LOCAL_ONLY no-push clause is superseded to exactly this extent; every other effect of DEC-0001 stands. Any future push requires its own explicit authorization. The push exists so that the GitHub Actions workflow committed on this branch (075f618) can produce the real CI run evidence required by R8-Phase-4.
decisions.reason: Round 8 Phase 1 found push authorization missing AND DEC-0001 contradictory (KI-15: branch tracks origin, ahead 11, reflog shows 'update by push'), and instructed: stop before any remote operation and report the exact decision needed. That exact decision was put to the User and explicitly granted: the User selected 'Authorize push + supersede DEC-0001 (Recommended)'. Without the push there is no real CI run, and the release verdict is capped at NOT_READY on missing evidence.
